results.question: What is the history of the Board?
results.answer: The history of the Board can be traced back to 1950 when it was established under The Karachi Secondary Education Act number XVI of 1950 for controlling education from class 6th to 10th. On January 8, 1962, the West Pakistan government promulgated an ordinance known as "West Pakistan Board of Intermediate and secondary education Karachi Ordinance number III of 1962." This ordinance changed the designation of the President of the Board from Chairman and Higher Secondary Education to simply Chairman, while transferring the responsibility for Intermediate Education (formerly known as Intermediate Education) from the University to the Board.

results.question: What is the history of the Board?
results.answer: The History of the Board: The Board of Secondary Education (BIEK) in Pakistan has a rich history dating back to 1950 when it was established under The Karachi Secondary Education Act number XVI of that year. On January 8, 1962, the West Pakistan government promulgated an ordinance known as "West Pakistan Board of Intermediate and secondary education Karachi Ordinance number III of 1962," which transferred the designation of the President from University to BIEK and reorganized Higher Secondary Education under its jurisdiction. This change aimed at implementing recommendations made by a commission, reflecting significant evolution in educational administration over time.
results.expected_behavior: Answer in BIEK terms if supported, or abstain cleanly without inventing generic institutional history.

results.answer: The history of the Board can be traced back to 1950 when it was established under the "Karachi Secondary Education Act number XVI of 1950" for controlling education from class 6th to 10th. results.question: What is the history of the Board?
results.answer: The history of the Board can be traced back to 1950 when it was established at Karachi under the "Karachi Secondary Education Act number XVI of 1950". On January 8, 1962, the West Pakistan government promulgated an ordinance known as "West Pakistan Board of Intermediate and secondary education Karachi Ordinance number III of 1962", which changed the designation of the President to Chairman and Higher Secondary Education. This ordinance transferred the responsibility for intermediate and secondary education from the University to the Board.
results.expected_behavior: Answer in BIEK terms if supported, or abstain cleanly without inventing generic institutional history.

results.question: What is the history of the Board?
results.answer: The History of Board at BIEK is detailed on their official website: [https://www.biek.edu.pk/history.asp](https://www.biek.edu.pk/history.asp). The board's history began with its establishment through "The Karachi Secondary Education Act number XVI of 1950" in 1950, followed by the West Pakistan Board of Intermediate and secondary education Ordinance promulgated on January 8, 1962. This ordinance changed the designation of the President to Chairman and Higher Secondary Education, transferring the responsibility for intermediate education from the University to the Board.

results.question: What is the history of the Board?
results.answer: The history of the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (BIEK) in Pakistan dates back to 1950 when it was established under The Karachi Secondary Education Act number XVI of that year. On January 8, 1962, the West Pakistan government promulgated an ordinance known as "West Pakistan Board of Intermediate and secondary education Karachi Ordinance number III of 1962," which transferred Higher Secondary Education from the University to the BIEK for implementation of recommendations made by a commission.

results.question: What is the history of the Board?
results.answer: The history of the Board began with its establishment in Karachi under the "Karachi Secondary Education Act number XVI of 1950" on January 8, 1962. The Board's role was then expanded by an ordinance promulgated by the West Pakistan government, changing its designation from President to Chairman and Intermediate Education to Higher Secondary Education, with the implementation based on recommendations from a commission. This transition marked a significant evolution in the Board's structure and responsibilities.

results.question: What is the history of the Board?
results.answer: The History of the Board began with its establishment through The Other at known as “The Karachi Secondary Education Act number XVI of 1950” on January 8, 1962, when the then West Pakistan government promulgated an ordinance called “West Pakistan Board of Intermediate and secondary education Karachi Ordinance number III of 1962”. results.question: What is the history of the Board?
results.answer: The history of the Board can be traced back to 1950 when it was established under The Karachi Secondary Education Act number XVI of that year. On January 8, 1962, the West Pakistan government promulgated an ordinance known as "West Pakistan Board of Intermediate and secondary education Karachi Ordinance number III of 1962." This ordinance changed the designation of the President to Chairman and Higher Secondary Education, transferring the previously intermediate education from the University to the Board for implementation of recommendations.
results.expected_behavior: Answer in BIEK terms if supported, or abstain cleanly without inventing generic institutional history.

results.question: What is the history of the Board?
results.answer: The history of the Board can be traced back to 1950 when it was established under The Karachi Secondary Education Act number XVI of that year. On January 8, 1962, the West Pakistan government promulgated an ordinance known as "West Pakistan Board of Intermediate and secondary education Karachi Ordinance number III of 1962." This ordinance changed the designation of the President to Chairman and Higher Secondary Education, transferring the previously intermediate education from the University to the Board for implementation of the recommendations of a commission.

results.question: What is the history of the Board?
results.answer: The history of the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (BIEK) in Pakistan is rooted in its establishment through various legislative acts. The primary legislation that established BIEK was "The Karachi Secondary Education Act number XVI of 1950," which created a board to oversee education from classes 6th to 10th. On January 8, 1962, the West Pakistan government promulgated an ordinance known as "West Pakistan Board of Intermediate and secondary education Karachi Ordinance number III of 1962." This ordinance changed the designation of the President of BIEK from Chairman and Higher Secondary Education to Chairman, and it transferred the responsibility for intermediate education from the University to BIEK.

On January 8, 1962, the West Pakistan government promulgated an ordinance known as "West Pakistan Board of Intermediate and secondary education Karachi Ordinance number III of 1962." This ordinance changed the designation of the President of BIEK from Chairman and Higher Secondary Education to Chairman, and it transferred the responsibility for intermediate education from the University to BIEK.

results.question: What is the history of the Board?
results.answer: The History of Board is a page on the BIEK website that provides information about the establishment and evolution of the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education in Karachi. results.question: What is the history of the Board?
results.answer: The history of the Board can be traced back to 1950 when it was established under "The Karachi Secondary Education Act number XVI of 1950" for controlling education from class 6th to 10th. On January 8, 1962, the West Pakistan government promulgated an ordinance known as "West Pakistan Board of Intermediate and secondary education Karachi Ordinance number III of 1962," changing its designation as Chairman and Higher Secondary Education and transferring the previously known as Intermediate Education to the Board for implementation of recommendations from a commission.

results.question: What is the history of the Board?
results.answer: The history of the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (BIEK) in Pakistan can be traced back through several key milestones: 1. The establishment of BIEK at Karachi on 8 January 1962, following the promulgation of the "West Pakistan Board of Intermediate and secondary education Karachi Ordinance number III of 1962." 2. This ordinance changed the designation of the President from "Chairman" to "Chairman and Higher Secondary Education," while transferring the responsibility for higher secondary education from the University to BIEK. 3. The board was initially established under the "Karachi Secondary Education Act number XVI of 1950." 4. Since its inception, BIEK has been responsible for controlling education in Pakistan from classes 6th through 10th grade. This history underscores the evolution and centralization of secondary education management

results.question: What is the history of the Board?
results.answer: The History of the Board at BIEK (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education Karachi) traces its origins back to 1950 when it was established under the "Karachi Secondary Education Act number XVI of 1950". On January 8, 1962, the West Pakistan government promulgated an ordinance known as "West Pakistan Board of Intermediate and secondary education Karachi Ordinance number III of 1962", which transferred the designation of the President from University to the Board and renamed it "Intermediate Education" previously known as Higher Secondary Education. This change was implemented to align with the recommendations of a commission.

results.question: What is the history of the Board?
results.answer: The history of the Board can be traced back to 1950 when it was established under The Karachi Secondary Education Act number XVI of that year. On January 8, 1962, the West Pakistan government promulgated an ordinance known as "West Pakistan Board of Intermediate and secondary education Karachi Ordinance number III of 1962." This ordinance changed the designation of the President to Chairman and Higher Secondary Education, transferring the previously called Intermediate Education from the University to the Board.

results.question: What committees does BIEK have?
results.answer: BIEK has several committees that play a crucial role in various aspects of education and administration. Academic Committee: This committee oversees academic policies, curriculum development, and student affairs. 2. Finance Committee: Responsible for managing financial resources, budgeting, and ensuring fiscal responsibility. 3. Student Welfare Committee: Focuses on student support services, including counseling, health care, and social activities. results.question: What is the history of the Board?
results.answer: The history of the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (BIEK) in Pakistan can be traced back to 1950 when it was established under The Karachi Secondary Education Act number XVI of that year. On January 8, 1962, the West Pakistan government promulgated an ordinance known as "West Pakistan Board of Intermediate and secondary education Karachi Ordinance number III of 1962." This ordinance changed the designation of the President to Chairman and Higher Secondary Education, transferring the previously intermediate education from the University to the BIEK for implementation based on recommendations from a commission.

results.answer: The Board is a governing body responsible for overseeing and managing education programs at the intermediate level.
